morning-dhikr.title: Morning Remembrance
morning-dhikr.subtitle: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah
morning-dhikr.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
morning-dhikr.translit: Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥa l-mulku lillāh, wal-ḥamdu lillāh, lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahū lā sharīka lah.
morning-dhikr.translation: We have entered the morning, and with us the whole dominion belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, without any partner.

ayat-al-kursi.title: Ayat al-Kursi
ayat-al-kursi.subtitle: Al-Baqarah 2:255
ayat-al-kursi.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
ayat-al-kursi.translit: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa l-ḥayyu l-qayyūm, lā taʾkhudhuhū sinatun wa lā nawm, lahū mā fī s-samāwāti wa mā fī l-arḍ, man dhā lladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahū illā bi-idhnih, yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wa mā khalfahum, wa lā yuḥīṭūna bi-shayʾin min ʿilmihī illā bi-mā shāʾ, wasiʿa kursiyyuhu s-samāwāti wa l-arḍ, wa lā yaʾūduhū ḥifẓuhumā, wa huwa l-ʿaliyyu l-ʿaẓīm.
ayat-al-kursi.translation: Allah — there is no god but Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on the earth. Who could intercede with Him without His permission? He knows what lies before His creation and what lies behind them, and they grasp none of His knowledge except what He wills. His throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and preserving them tires Him not. He is the Most High, the Most Great.
ayat-al-kursi.reference: Qur'an 2:255 — Hisn al-Muslim 75, recited morning and evening for protection

sayyidul-istighfar.title: Sayyidul Istighfar
sayyidul-istighfar.subtitle: The Master Supplication for Forgiveness
sayyidul-istighfar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
sayyidul-istighfar.translit: Allāhumma anta Rabbī lā ilāha illā ant, khalaqtanī wa anā ʿabduk, wa anā ʿalā ʿahdika wa waʿdika mastaṭaʿt, aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣanaʿt, abūʾu laka bi niʿmatika ʿalayya, wa abūʾu bidhanbī faghfir lī, fa-innahū lā yaghfirudh-dhunūba illā ant.
sayyidul-istighfar.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is none worthy of worship but You. You created me and I am Your slave. I keep Your covenant and my pledge to You so far as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessing upon me, and I acknowledge my sin. Forgive me, for there is none who may forgive sins but You.
sayyidul-istighfar.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 79 (Al-Bukhari 7/150) — whoever recites this with conviction in the morning and dies that day enters Paradise

morning-wellbeing.title: For Wellbeing in Body, Hearing and Sight
morning-wellbeing.subtitle: Recite three times
morning-wellbeing.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
morning-wellbeing.translit: Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī badanī, Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī samʿī, Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī baṣarī, lā ilāha illā ant. (×3)
morning-wellbeing.translation: O Allah, make me healthy in my body. O Allah, preserve for me my hearing. O Allah, preserve for me my sight. There is none worthy of worship but You.
morning-wellbeing.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 82 (Abu Dawud 4/324, Ahmad 5/42) — recite three times

morning-sufficient.title: Allah is Sufficient for Me
morning-sufficient.subtitle: Recite seven times
morning-sufficient.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
morning-sufficient.translit: Ḥasbiyallāhu lā ilāha illā huwa ʿalayhi tawakkaltu, wa huwa Rabbu l-ʿArshi l-ʿAẓīm. (×7)
morning-sufficient.translation: Allah is sufficient for me. There is none worthy of worship but Him. I have placed my trust in Him, He is Lord of the Majestic Throne.
morning-sufficient.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 83 (Ibn As-Sunni, Abu Dawud 4/321) — recite seven times in the morning or evening

hundred-hasanat.title: None Has the Right to Be Worshipped But Allah
hundred-hasanat.subtitle: Recite ten times (or one hundred for the fuller reward)
hundred-hasanat.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
hundred-hasanat.translit: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahu l-mulku wa lahu l-ḥamd, wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. (×10)
hundred-hasanat.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, He has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is able to do all things.
hundred-hasanat.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 92 (An-Nasa'i, 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah) — recited ten times, this carries the reward of freeing ten slaves; recited one hundred times a day carries the reward of freeing ten slaves from the Children of Isma'il, plus one hundred good deeds recorded and one hundred sins erased (Al-Bukhari, Muslim)

two-light-words.title: Two Phrases Light on the Tongue
two-light-words.subtitle: Beloved to the Most Merciful, heavy on the Scale
two-light-words.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
two-light-words.translation: Glory be to Allah and praise Him, glory be to Allah the Magnificent.
two-light-words.reference: Al-Bukhari 6682, Muslim 2694 — two phrases light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale, and beloved to the Most Merciful

four-witnesses-morning.title: Bearing Witness at the Start of the Day
four-witnesses-morning.subtitle: Recite four times
four-witnesses-morning.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
four-witnesses-morning.translit: Allāhumma innī aṣbaḥtu ush-hiduka wa ush-hidu ḥamalata ʿarshik, wa malāʾikataka wa jamīʿa khalqik, annaka anta-llāhu lā ilāha illā ant, waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, wa anna Muḥammadan ʿabduka wa rasūluk. (×4)
four-witnesses-morning.translation: O Allah, I have entered a new morning and call upon You and upon the bearers of Your Throne, upon Your angels and all creation to bear witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped but You alone, You have no partner, and that Muhammad is Your slave and Your Messenger.
four-witnesses-morning.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 80 (Abu Dawud 4/317) — whoever says this four times in the morning or evening, Allah spares them from the Fire

four-witnesses-evening.title: Bearing Witness at the Close of the Day
four-witnesses-evening.subtitle: Recite four times
four-witnesses-evening.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَمْسَيْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
four-witnesses-evening.translit: Allāhumma innī amsaytu ush-hiduka wa ush-hidu ḥamalata ʿarshik, wa malāʾikataka wa jamīʿa khalqik, annaka anta-llāhu lā ilāha illā ant, waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, wa anna Muḥammadan ʿabduka wa rasūluk. (×4)
four-witnesses-evening.translation: O Allah, I have entered a new evening and call upon You and upon the bearers of Your Throne, upon Your angels and all creation to bear witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped but You alone, You have no partner, and that Muhammad is Your slave and Your Messenger.
four-witnesses-evening.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 80 (Abu Dawud 4/317) — evening form of the same witnessing du'a; Allah spares from the Fire whoever recites it four times

fitrah-morning.title: Upon the Fitrah of Islam
fitrah-morning.subtitle: Rising upon the natural religion
fitrah-morning.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَىٰ فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَعَلَىٰ كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَىٰ دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، وَعَلَىٰ مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
fitrah-morning.translit: Aṣbaḥnā ʿalā fiṭrati l-Islām, wa ʿalā kalimati l-ikhlāṣ, wa ʿalā dīni Nabiyyinā Muḥammadin (ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam), wa ʿalā millati abīnā Ibrāhīm, ḥanīfan musliman wa mā kāna minal-mushrikīn.
fitrah-morning.translation: We have risen this morning upon the fitrah of Islam, upon the word of pure faith, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and upon the way of our father Ibrahim, who was upright and submitted to Allah, and was not of those who associate partners with Him.
fitrah-morning.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 90 (Ahmad 3/406-407, 3/439) — narrated by Ibn 'Umar; the evening form substitutes 'amsaynā' (we have entered the evening) for 'aṣbaḥnā'

blessing-from-you.title: Every Blessing Is From You Alone
blessing-from-you.subtitle: A short acknowledgement of Allah's favour
blessing-from-you.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
blessing-from-you.translit: Allāhumma mā aṣbaḥa bī min niʿmatin aw bi-aḥadin min khalqik, fa-minka waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, fa-lakal-ḥamdu wa lakash-shukr.
blessing-from-you.translation: O Allah, whatever blessing I or any of Your creation have risen upon this morning is from You alone, without partner. So to You belongs all praise and to You belongs all thanks.
blessing-from-you.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 81 (Abu Dawud, Ibn As-Sunni) — whoever says this has fulfilled their thanks for that day

afw-afiyah.title: Pardon and Well-Being in Every Direction
afw-afiyah.subtitle: Comprehensive protection for the day ahead
afw-afiyah.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
afw-afiyah.translit: Allāhumma innī asʾalukal-ʿafwa wal-ʿāfiyata fid-dunyā wal-ākhirah. Allāhumma innī asʾalukal-ʿafwa wal-ʿāfiyata fī dīnī wa dunyāya wa ahlī wa mālī. Allāhummastur ʿawrātī wa āmin rawʿātī. Allāhumma ḥfaẓnī min bayni yadayya wa min khalfī wa ʿan yamīnī wa ʿan shimālī wa min fawqī, wa aʿūdhu biʿaẓamatika an ughtāla min taḥtī.
afw-afiyah.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this life and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religious and worldly affairs, and my family and my wealth. O Allah, veil my weaknesses and ease my fears. O Allah, protect me from in front of me, from behind me, from my right, from my left, and from above me, and I take refuge in Your greatness from being seized from beneath me.

witness-unseen-seen.title: Bearing Witness to the Knower of the Unseen
witness-unseen-seen.subtitle: Refuge from the evil of one's own soul
witness-unseen-seen.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ
witness-unseen-seen.translit: Allāhumma ʿālimal-ghaybi wash-shahādah, fāṭiras-samāwāti wal-arḍ, Rabba kulli shayʾin wa malīkah, ash-hadu an lā ilāha illā ant, aʿūdhu bika min sharri nafsī wa min sharrish-shayṭāni wa shirkih.
witness-unseen-seen.translation: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things — I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped but You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my own soul and from the evil of Shaytan and his shirk.

bismillah-protection.title: Nothing Can Cause Harm With This Name
bismillah-protection.subtitle: Recite three times
bismillah-protection.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
bismillah-protection.translit: Bismillāhil-ladhī lā yaḍurru maʿa smihi shayʾun fil-arḍi wa lā fis-samāʾi wa huwas-Samīʿul-ʿAlīm. (×3)
bismillah-protection.translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
bismillah-protection.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 86 (Abu Dawud, At-Tirmidhi) — whoever recites this three times will not be struck by sudden affliction until the next morning or evening

ya-hayyu-ya-qayyum.title: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer
ya-hayyu-ya-qayyum.subtitle: Seeking Allah's mercy for every affair
ya-hayyu-ya-qayyum.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَىٰ نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
ya-hayyu-ya-qayyum.translit: Yā Ḥayyu yā Qayyūmu bi-raḥmatika astaghīth, aṣliḥ lī shaʾnī kullah, wa lā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfata ʿayn.
ya-hayyu-ya-qayyum.translation: O Ever-Living, O Self-Subsisting Sustainer of all, by Your mercy I seek relief. Set right all of my affairs, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.

khayra-hadhal-yawm.title: The Good of This Day
khayra-hadhal-yawm.subtitle: Asking for its triumphs and guidance
khayra-hadhal-yawm.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَٰذَا الْيَوْمِ فَتْحَهُ وَنَصْرَهُ وَنُورَهُ وَبَرَكَتَهُ وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
khayra-hadhal-yawm.translit: Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥal-mulku lillāhi Rabbil-ʿālamīn. Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayra hādhal-yawm: fatḥahu wa naṣrahu wa nūrahu wa barakatahu wa hudāh, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fīhi wa sharri mā baʿdah.
khayra-hadhal-yawm.translation: We have entered the morning, and with us the whole dominion of Allah, Lord of all the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day: its triumphs, its help, its light, its blessing, and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil in it and the evil that follows it.
khayra-hadhal-yawm.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 89 (Abu Dawud) — evening form substitutes 'this night' for 'this day'

subhanallahi-hundred.title: Subhanallahi wa Bihamdihi
subhanallahi-hundred.subtitle: Recite one hundred times
subhanallahi-hundred.translation: How perfect Allah is, and I praise Him.
subhanallahi-hundred.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 91 (Muslim) — whoever says this one hundred times a day will have their sins forgiven, even if they are like the foam of the sea

subhanallahi-extended.title: By the Weight of His Throne
subhanallahi-extended.subtitle: Recite three times
subhanallahi-extended.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
subhanallahi-extended.translit: Subḥānallāhi wa biḥamdih, ʿadada khalqih, wa riḍā nafsih, wa zinata ʿarshih, wa midāda kalimātih. (×3)
subhanallahi-extended.translation: How perfect Allah is, and I praise Him, by the number of His creation, by His pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the extent of His words.

evening-dhikr.title: Evening Remembrance
evening-dhikr.subtitle: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillah
evening-dhikr.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
evening-dhikr.translit: Amsaynā wa amsal-mulku lillāh, wal-ḥamdu lillāh, lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahū lā sharīka lah.
evening-dhikr.translation: We have entered the evening, and with us the whole dominion belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, without any partner.

evening-protection.title: Refuge in Allah's Perfect Words
evening-protection.subtitle: Recite three times in the evening
evening-protection.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
evening-protection.translit: Aʿūdhu bikalimāti-llāhit-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq. (×3)
evening-protection.translation: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
evening-protection.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 97 (Ahmad 2/290, At-Tirmidhi 3/187) — protects from insect stings and harm through the night

evening-pleased.title: Pleased with Allah as Lord
evening-pleased.subtitle: Recite three times
evening-pleased.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيًّا
evening-pleased.translit: Raḍītu billāhi Rabban, wa bil-Islāmi dīnan, wa bi-Muḥammadin (ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam) nabiyyan. (×3)
evening-pleased.translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet.
evening-pleased.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 87 (Ahmad 4/337, At-Tirmidhi 5/465) — Allah has promised whoever says this three times every morning or evening will be pleased on the Day of Resurrection

tasbih-33.title: Tasbih, Tahmid and Takbir
tasbih-33.subtitle: 33, 33 and 34 times
tasbih-33.translit: Subḥān Allāh (×33) — Alḥamdu lillāh (×33) — Allāhu akbar (×34)
tasbih-33.translation: Glory be to Allah (33 times). Praise be to Allah (33 times). Allah is the greatest (34 times).
tasbih-33.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 69 (Muslim 1/418) — whoever says this after every prayer will be forgiven, even if his sins are like the foam of the sea

dua-after-salah.title: Remembrance After Salam
dua-after-salah.subtitle: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah
dua-after-salah.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
dua-after-salah.translit: Lā ilāha illallāh, waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahu l-mulku wa lahu l-ḥamd, wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. Allāhumma lā māniʿa limā aʿṭayt, wa lā muʿṭiya limā manaʿt, wa lā yanfaʿu dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd.
dua-after-salah.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, He has no partner, His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is able to do all things. O Allah, there is none who can withhold what You give, and none may give what You have withheld, and the might of the mighty person cannot benefit him against You.

ayat-al-kursi-salah.title: Ayat al-Kursi After Prayer
ayat-al-kursi-salah.subtitle: Recite after each obligatory prayer
ayat-al-kursi-salah.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ...
ayat-al-kursi-salah.translit: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa l-ḥayyu l-qayyūm... (full verse — see Ayat al-Kursi card)
ayat-al-kursi-salah.translation: See the full translation under Ayat al-Kursi. Reciting it after every obligatory prayer is one of the most emphasized daily practices in the Sunnah.
ayat-al-kursi-salah.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 71 (An-Nasa'i, 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah, no. 100) — to be recited in Arabic after each prayer
ayat-al-kursi-salah.pointerNote: This is the same Ayat al-Kursi (Qur'an 2:255) found in the Morning card — recited again here specifically after each of the five daily prayers.

three-quls.title: The Three Quls
three-quls.subtitle: Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas
three-quls.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 70 & 76 (Qur'an 112, 113 & 114) — recited after each prayer (3× after Fajr and Maghrib), and morning, evening and before sleep for protection.

parts.label: Al-Ikhlas (112)
parts.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ. اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ. لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ. وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
parts.translit: Qul huwa llāhu aḥad, Allāhu ṣ-ṣamad, lam yalid wa lam yūlad, wa lam yakul lahū kufuwan aḥad.
parts.translation: Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He does not give birth, nor was He born. And there is none comparable to Him.

parts.label: Al-Falaq (113)
parts.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ. مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ. وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ. وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ. وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
parts.translit: Qul aʿūdhu bi-rabbi l-falaq, min sharri mā khalaq, wa min sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab, wa min sharri n-naffāthāti fī l-ʿuqad, wa min sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad.
parts.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak, from the evil of what He has created, from the evil of darkness as it settles, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.

parts.label: An-Nas (114)
parts.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ. مَلِكِ النَّاسِ. إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ. مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ. الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ. مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
parts.translit: Qul aʿūdhu bi-rabbi n-nās, maliki n-nās, ilāhi n-nās, min sharri l-waswāsi l-khannās, alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūri n-nās, mina l-jinnati wa n-nās.
parts.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer, who whispers in the hearts of people, from among the jinn and mankind.

istikhara.title: Prayer of Guidance (Istikhara)
istikhara.subtitle: For seeking Allah's counsel in a decision
istikhara.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ
istikhara.translit: Allāhumma innī astakhīruka biʿilmik, wa astaqdiruka biqudratik, wa asʾaluka min faḍlika l-ʿaẓīm, fa-innaka taqdiru wa lā aqdir, wa taʿlamu wa lā aʿlam, wa anta ʿallāmu l-ghuyūb.
istikhara.translation: O Allah, I seek Your counsel through Your knowledge, and I seek ability through Your power, and I ask You from Your immense favour. You are able and I am not, You know and I do not, and You are the Knower of the unseen. [Continue: 'O Allah, if You know that this matter is good for me in my religion, my livelihood, and the outcome of my affairs, then decree it for me, make it easy for me, and bless me in it...']
istikhara.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 74 (Al-Bukhari 7/162) — pray two rak'ahs other than the obligatory prayer, then recite this in full

sajdah-mulk.title: Surah al-Sajdah & Surah al-Mulk
sajdah-mulk.subtitle: Recite both Surahs
sajdah-mulk.pointerNote: These are two full Surahs (32 and 67), recited by the Prophet ﷺ before sleep. Read them in full in the Qur'an section — this card will link straight there once the two sections are connected.
sajdah-mulk.reference: At-Tirmidhi 5/159, authenticated by Al-Albani — the Prophet ﷺ would not sleep until he had recited Alif Lam Mim Tanzil (as-Sajdah) and Tabarakalladhi (al-Mulk)

ayat-al-kursi-sleep.title: Ayat al-Kursi Before Sleep
ayat-al-kursi-sleep.subtitle: Al-Baqarah 2:255
ayat-al-kursi-sleep.pointerNote: The same Ayat al-Kursi found in the Morning card. Whoever recites it before sleeping will have a guardian from Allah remain with them through the night.

last-two-baqarah.title: Last Two Ayahs of Surah al-Baqarah
last-two-baqarah.arabic: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ رُسُلِهِ ۚ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ. لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
last-two-baqarah.translit: Āmana r-rasūlu bimā unzila ilayhi mir rabbihī wal-muʾminūn... Rabbanā lā tuʾākhidhnā in nasīnā aw akhṭaʾnā, rabbanā wa lā taḥmil ʿalaynā iṣran kamā ḥamaltahū ʿalā lladhīna min qablinā, rabbanā wa lā tuḥammilnā mā lā ṭāqata lanā bih, waʿfu ʿannā waghfir lanā warḥamnā, anta mawlānā fanṣurnā ʿalā l-qawmi l-kāfirīn.
last-two-baqarah.translation: The Messenger believes in what has been sent down to him from his Lord, and so do the believers. Each one believes in Allah, His angels, His books, and His messengers — 'We make no distinction between any of His messengers.' And they say: 'We hear and we obey; grant us Your forgiveness, our Lord, for to You is the return.' Allah does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear... 'Our Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, do not place upon us a burden like the one You placed on those before us. Our Lord, do not burden us with more than we have strength to bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us — You are our Protector, so grant us victory over the disbelieving people.'
last-two-baqarah.reference: Qur'an 2:285-286 — Hisn al-Muslim 101 (Al-Bukhari 9/94, Muslim 1/554), sufficient for anyone who recites it at night before sleeping

al-kafirun.title: Surah al-Kafirun
al-kafirun.subtitle: Recite before sleep
al-kafirun.arabic: قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ. لَا أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ. وَلَا أَنْتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ. وَلَا أَنَا عَابِدٌ مَا عَبَدْتُمْ. وَلَا أَنْتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ. وَلَا لَكُمْ دِينِ
al-kafirun.translit: Qul yā ayyuhā l-kāfirūn, lā aʿbudu mā taʿbudūn, wa lā antum ʿābidūna mā aʿbud, wa lā ana ʿābidun mā ʿabadtum, wa lā antum ʿābidūna mā aʿbud, lakum dīnukum wa liya dīn.
al-kafirun.translation: Say: O disbelievers — I do not worship what you worship, nor do you worship what I worship. I will not worship what you worship, nor will you worship what I worship. You have your way, and I have mine.
al-kafirun.reference: Qur'an 109:1-6 — reported as recited by the Prophet ﷺ before sleep, described as 'freedom from shirk'

tasbih-fatima.title: Tasbih Fatimah (before sleep)
tasbih-fatima.subtitle: 33, 33 and 34 times
tasbih-fatima.translit: Subḥān Allāh (×33) — Alḥamdu lillāh (×33) — Allāhu akbar (×34)
tasbih-fatima.translation: Glory be to Allah (33 times). Praise be to Allah (33 times). Allah is the greatest (34 times).
tasbih-fatima.reference: Al-Bukhari 7/71, Muslim 4/2091 — taught by the Prophet ﷺ to Fatimah (RA) instead of a servant, described as better than what she had asked for

mercy-protection.title: By Your Name I Die and Live
mercy-protection.subtitle: Upon lying down to sleep
mercy-protection.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

sleep-soul.title: You Created My Soul
sleep-soul.subtitle: Comprehensive night supplication
sleep-soul.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا، لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْيَاهَا، إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ
sleep-soul.translit: Allāhumma innaka khalaqta nafsī wa anta tawaffāhā, laka mamātuhā wa maḥyāhā, in aḥyaytahā faḥfaẓhā, wa in amattahā faghfir lahā. Allāhumma innī asʾaluka l-ʿāfiyah.
sleep-soul.translation: O Allah, You have created my soul and You take it back. Unto You is its death and its life. If You give it life then protect it, and if You cause it to die then forgive it. O Allah, I ask You for well-being.

sleep-punishment.title: Save Me From Your Punishment
sleep-punishment.subtitle: Upon lying down, hand under cheek
sleep-punishment.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
sleep-punishment.translit: Allāhumma qinī ʿadhābaka yawma tabʿathu ʿibādak.
sleep-punishment.translation: O Allah, save me from Your punishment on the Day that You resurrect Your slaves.
sleep-punishment.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 104 (Abu Dawud 4/311) — the Prophet ﷺ would place his right hand under his cheek and say this before sleeping

salawat.title: The Ibrahimi Prayer
salawat.subtitle: Blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ (after tashahhud)
salawat.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ. اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
salawat.translit: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammadin, kamā ṣallayta ʿalā Ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli Ibrāhīma, innaka ḥamīdum-majīd. Allāhumma bārik ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammadin, kamā bārakta ʿalā Ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli Ibrāhīma, innaka ḥamīdum-majīd.
salawat.translation: O Allah, bestow Your favour on Muhammad and on the family of Muhammad as You have bestowed Your favour on Ibrahim and on the family of Ibrahim, You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You have blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim, You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious.
salawat.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 53 (Al-Bukhari, Fath al-Bari 6/408) — the standard form of salawat recited in every prayer

salawat-short.title: Short Salawat
salawat-short.subtitle: Recite ten times, morning and evening
salawat-short.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَىٰ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
salawat-short.translit: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā nabiyyinā Muḥammad. (×10)
salawat-short.translation: O Allah, send Your blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
salawat-short.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 98 — the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Whoever sends blessings upon me ten times in the morning and ten times in the evening will obtain my intercession on the Day of Resurrection.' (At-Tabarani, graded good by Al-Albani)

salawat-tenfold.title: The Reward of a Single Salawat
salawat-tenfold.subtitle: Sending blessings once
salawat-tenfold.pointerNote: There is no fixed wording required — any authentic form of salawat (such as the Ibrahimi prayer above) fulfils this.
salawat-tenfold.reference: Sunan an-Nasa'i 1297 — the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Whoever sends salah upon me once, Allah will send salah upon him tenfold, will erase ten sins from him, and will raise him ten degrees in status.'

subhanallah-bihamdihi.title: Glory and Praise be to Allah
subhanallah-bihamdihi.subtitle: Recite one hundred times
subhanallah-bihamdihi.translation: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him.
subhanallah-bihamdihi.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 91 (Al-Bukhari 4/2071) — whoever recites this one hundred times a day will have their sins forgiven even if as much as the foam of the sea

subhanallah-adad.title: By the Multitude of His Creation
subhanallah-adad.subtitle: Recite three times, upon rising
subhanallah-adad.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
subhanallah-adad.translit: Subḥānallāhi wa biḥamdih: ʿadada khalqih, wa riḍā nafsih, wa zinata ʿarshih, wa midāda kalimātih. (×3)
subhanallah-adad.translation: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him, by the multitude of His creation, by His Pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the extent of His Words.

rabbana-atina.title: Rabbana Atina
rabbana-atina.subtitle: Al-Baqarah 2:201
rabbana-atina.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
rabbana-atina.translit: Rabbanā ātinā fid-dunyā ḥasanatan wa fil-ākhirati ḥasanatan wa qinā ʿadhāban-nār.
rabbana-atina.translation: Our Lord, grant us goodness in this world, goodness in the Hereafter, and protect us from the torment of the Fire.
rabbana-atina.reference: Qur'an 2:201 — the supplication most often recited by the Prophet ﷺ (Al-Bukhari and Muslim)

rabbi-zidni-ilma.title: Rabbi Zidni Ilma
rabbi-zidni-ilma.subtitle: Ta-Ha 20:114
rabbi-zidni-ilma.translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
rabbi-zidni-ilma.reference: Qur'an 20:114 — the only supplication Allah specifically instructed the Prophet ﷺ to make in the Qur'an

rabbana-la-tuzigh.title: Rabbana La Tuzigh
rabbana-la-tuzigh.subtitle: Aal-Imran 3:8
rabbana-la-tuzigh.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
rabbana-la-tuzigh.translit: Rabbanā lā tuzigh qulūbanā baʿda idh hadaytanā wa hab lanā min ladunka raḥmatan innaka anta l-Wahhāb.
rabbana-la-tuzigh.translation: Our Lord, do not let our hearts turn away after You have guided us. Grant us mercy from You. Truly, You are the Bestower.

rabbana-zulm.title: Rabbana Zalamna
rabbana-zulm.subtitle: Al-A'raf 7:23 — the du'a of Adam and Hawwa
rabbana-zulm.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
rabbana-zulm.translit: Rabbanā ẓalamnā anfusanā wa in lam taghfir lanā wa tarḥamnā lanakūnanna mina l-khāsirīn.
rabbana-zulm.translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves. If You do not forgive us and show us mercy, we will surely be among the losers.
rabbana-zulm.reference: Qur'an 7:23 — the words of repentance of Adam and Hawwa after the forbidden tree

rabbana-afrigh.title: Rabbana Afrigh
rabbana-afrigh.subtitle: Al-Baqarah 2:250 — the du'a of Dawud's army
rabbana-afrigh.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
rabbana-afrigh.translit: Rabbanā afrigh ʿalaynā ṣabran wa thabbit aqdāmanā wa-nṣurnā ʿalā l-qawmi l-kāfirīn.
rabbana-afrigh.translation: Our Lord, pour patience upon us, make our steps firm, and grant us victory over those who reject faith.
rabbana-afrigh.reference: Qur'an 2:250 — recited by the believers facing Jalut (Goliath)

rabbi-ishrah.title: Rabbi Ishrah Li Sadri
rabbi-ishrah.subtitle: Ta-Ha 20:25-28 — the du'a of Musa
rabbi-ishrah.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي، وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي، وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِي، يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
rabbi-ishrah.translit: Rabbi shraḥ lī ṣadrī, wa yassir lī amrī, wa ḥlul ʿuqdatan min lisānī, yafqahū qawlī.
rabbi-ishrah.translation: My Lord, expand for me my chest, ease my task for me, and remove the knot from my tongue, so they may understand my speech.
rabbi-ishrah.reference: Qur'an 20:25-28 — Musa's du'a before speaking to Pharaoh

rabbi-inni-lima.title: Rabbi Inni Lima Anzalta
rabbi-inni-lima.subtitle: Al-Qasas 28:24 — the du'a of Musa at Madyan
rabbi-inni-lima.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
rabbi-inni-lima.translit: Rabbi innī limā anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqīr.
rabbi-inni-lima.translation: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.
rabbi-inni-lima.reference: Qur'an 28:24 — Musa's du'a after fleeing Egypt, having nothing but reliance on Allah

yunus-la-ilaha.title: La ilaha illa Anta
yunus-la-ilaha.subtitle: Al-Anbiya 21:87 — the du'a of Yunus
yunus-la-ilaha.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
yunus-la-ilaha.translit: Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu mina ẓ-ẓālimīn.
yunus-la-ilaha.translation: There is no god but You, glory be to You. Indeed, I was among the wrongdoers.
yunus-la-ilaha.reference: Qur'an 21:87 — the du'a of Yunus (Jonah) in the belly of the whale. The Prophet ﷺ said whoever supplicates with it will be answered (At-Tirmidhi)

astaghfirullah.title: Astaghfirullah
astaghfirullah.subtitle: I seek the forgiveness of Allah
astaghfirullah.translation: I seek the forgiveness of Allah.
astaghfirullah.reference: A short, easily repeated form of istighfar recited throughout the day and after prayer

la-ilaha-illallah.title: La ilaha illallah
la-ilaha-illallah.subtitle: The best of what has been said
la-ilaha-illallah.translation: There is no god but Allah.
la-ilaha-illallah.reference: At-Tirmidhi — the Prophet ﷺ said the best that he and the prophets before him have said is this declaration

rabbighfir-tub.title: Rabbighfir li wa Tub Alayya
rabbighfir-tub.subtitle: Recited by the Prophet ﷺ 100 times in one sitting
rabbighfir-tub.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
rabbighfir-tub.translit: Rabbighfir lī wa tub ʿalayya, innaka Antat-Tawwābur-Raḥīm.
rabbighfir-tub.translation: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepter of repentance, the Most Merciful.
rabbighfir-tub.reference: Sunan Abi Dawud 1516, Jami' at-Tirmidhi 3434, Sunan Ibn Majah 3814 — Ibn Umar (RA) counted the Prophet ﷺ saying this a hundred times in a single sitting

astaghfirullah-full.title: The Fuller Istighfar
astaghfirullah-full.subtitle: I seek forgiveness of Allah, besides Whom there is no god
astaghfirullah-full.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
astaghfirullah-full.translit: Astaghfirullāh alladhī lā ilāha illā huwal-Ḥayyul-Qayyūmu wa atūbu ilayh.
astaghfirullah-full.translation: I seek the forgiveness of Allah, besides Whom there is no god, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting, and I turn to Him in repentance.
astaghfirullah-full.reference: Abu Dawud, At-Tirmidhi, and Al-Hakim — whoever says this will be forgiven even if they had fled the battlefield

subhanallah-general.title: Subhanallah wa Bihamdihi
subhanallah-general.subtitle: The most beloved words to Allah
subhanallah-general.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
subhanallah-general.translation: Glory be to Allah and praise is to Him. Glory be to Allah, the Magnificent.
subhanallah-general.reference: Al-Bukhari 7/168, Muslim 4/2072 — two phrases described by the Prophet ﷺ as light on the tongue, heavy on the scale, and beloved to the Most Merciful

dua-ummah.title: Allahumma Aslih Ummata Muhammad
dua-ummah.subtitle: For the wellbeing of the Ummah
dua-ummah.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ أُمَّةَ مُحَمَّدٍ. اللَّهُمَّ فَرِّجْ عَنْ أُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ. اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْ أُمَّةَ مُحَمَّدٍ
dua-ummah.translit: Allāhumma aṣliḥ Ummata Muḥammad. Allāhumma farrij ʿan Ummati Muḥammad. Allāhumma rḥam Ummata Muḥammad ﷺ.
dua-ummah.translation: O Allah, set right the affairs of the Ummah of Muhammad. O Allah, grant relief to the Ummah of Muhammad. O Allah, have mercy on the Ummah of Muhammad.
dua-ummah.reference: A widely-used supplication for the Muslim community, especially recited during Dhul Hijjah and times of collective hardship

dua-ibrahim-descendants.title: Rabbi Ij'alni Muqim as-Salah
dua-ibrahim-descendants.subtitle: Ibrahim 14:37-41 — Ibrahim's du'a for his descendants
dua-ibrahim-descendants.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنِّي أَسْكَنْتُ مِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِي زَرْعٍ عِنْدَ بَيْتِكَ الْمُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ فَاجْعَلْ أَفْئِدَةً مِنَ النَّاسِ تَهْوِي إِلَيْهِمْ وَارْزُقْهُمْ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُونَ
dua-ibrahim-descendants.translit: Rabbanā innī askantu min dhurriyyatī bi-wādin ghayri dhī zarʿin ʿinda baytika l-muḥarram, rabbanā li-yuqīmū ṣ-ṣalāta fa-jʿal afʾidatan mina n-nāsi tahwī ilayhim wa rzuqhum mina ṯ-ṯamarāti laʿallahum yashkurūn.
dua-ibrahim-descendants.translation: Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in a barren valley near Your Sacred House, our Lord, that they may establish prayer. So make hearts among the people incline toward them, and provide for them from the fruits that they might be grateful.
dua-ibrahim-descendants.reference: Qur'an 14:37 — Ibrahim's supplication for the Muslim community he left at the Ka'bah, before it was ever inhabited

rabbana-ighfir-lana.title: Rabbana Ighfir Lana wa li Ikhwanina
rabbana-ighfir-lana.subtitle: Al-Hashr 59:10 — du'a for fellow believers
rabbana-ighfir-lana.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ
rabbana-ighfir-lana.translit: Rabbanā ighfir lanā wa li-ikhwāninā lladhīna sabaqūnā bil-īmāni wa lā tajʿal fī qulūbinā ghillan lilladhīna āmanū rabbanā innaka Raʾūfur-Raḥīm.
rabbana-ighfir-lana.translation: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith, and do not let there be resentment in our hearts toward those who believe. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful.
rabbana-ighfir-lana.reference: Qur'an 59:10 — a du'a made on behalf of the wider community of believers, past and present

dua-victory-islam.title: For the Aid of Islam and the Muslims
dua-victory-islam.subtitle: A call for strength and unity
dua-victory-islam.translation: O Allah, grant honour and strength to Islam and the Muslims.
dua-victory-islam.reference: Musnad Ahmad, narrated from Anas ibn Malik (RA) — hadith no. 12695

name-ar-rahman.title: Ar-Rahman
name-ar-rahman.subtitle: The Entirely Merciful
name-ar-rahman.translation: The Entirely Merciful — whose mercy encompasses all creation.

name-ar-raheem.title: Ar-Raheem
name-ar-raheem.subtitle: The Especially Merciful
name-ar-raheem.translation: The Especially Merciful — whose mercy is directed particularly toward the believers.

name-al-malik.title: Al-Malik
name-al-malik.subtitle: The Sovereign King
name-al-malik.translation: The Sovereign King, the true Owner of all dominion.

name-al-quddus.title: Al-Quddus
name-al-quddus.subtitle: The Absolutely Pure
name-al-quddus.translation: The Absolutely Pure, free from any imperfection.

name-as-salam.title: As-Salam
name-as-salam.subtitle: The Giver of Peace
name-as-salam.translation: The Source of Peace and Safety, free from every defect.

name-al-mumin.title: Al-Mu'min
name-al-mumin.subtitle: The Granter of Security
name-al-mumin.translation: The Granter of security and faith to His creation.

name-al-muhaymin.title: Al-Muhaymin
name-al-muhaymin.subtitle: The Guardian Overseer
name-al-muhaymin.translation: The Guardian and Overseer of all things.

name-al-aziz.title: Al-Aziz
name-al-aziz.subtitle: The All-Mighty
name-al-aziz.translation: The Almighty, whose might is never overcome.

name-al-jabbar.title: Al-Jabbar
name-al-jabbar.subtitle: The Restorer & Compeller
name-al-jabbar.translation: The Compeller, who restores and repairs the affairs of His creation.

name-al-mutakabbir.title: Al-Mutakabbir
name-al-mutakabbir.subtitle: The Supremely Great
name-al-mutakabbir.translation: The Supremely Great, above every imperfection ascribed to Him.

name-al-khaliq.title: Al-Khaliq
name-al-khaliq.subtitle: The Creator of All
name-al-khaliq.translation: The Creator, who brings all things into being from nothing.

name-al-bari.title: Al-Bari'
name-al-bari.subtitle: The Evolver
name-al-bari.translation: The Evolver, who shapes creation free from any flaw.

name-al-musawwir.title: Al-Musawwir
name-al-musawwir.subtitle: The Fashioner of Forms
name-al-musawwir.translation: The Fashioner, who gives every creation its unique form.

name-al-ghaffar.title: Al-Ghaffar
name-al-ghaffar.subtitle: The Oft-Forgiving
name-al-ghaffar.translation: The Repeatedly Forgiving, who forgives sins again and again.

name-al-qahhar.title: Al-Qahhar
name-al-qahhar.subtitle: The Subduer of All
name-al-qahhar.translation: The Subduer, before whom all creation is powerless.

name-al-wahhab.title: Al-Wahhab
name-al-wahhab.subtitle: The Bestower of Gifts
name-al-wahhab.translation: The Bestower, who gives freely and without limit.

name-ar-razzaq.title: Ar-Razzaq
name-ar-razzaq.subtitle: The Provider of Sustenance
name-ar-razzaq.translation: The Provider, who sustains every creature.

name-al-fattah.title: Al-Fattah
name-al-fattah.subtitle: The Opener of Ways
name-al-fattah.translation: The Opener, who opens the way to mercy, provision and judgement.

name-al-alim.title: Al-Alim
name-al-alim.subtitle: The All-Knowing
name-al-alim.translation: The All-Knowing, whose knowledge encompasses everything.

name-al-qabid.title: Al-Qabid
name-al-qabid.subtitle: The Withholder of Provision
name-al-qabid.translation: The One who withholds provision by His wisdom.

name-al-basit.title: Al-Basit
name-al-basit.subtitle: The Expander of Provision
name-al-basit.translation: The One who expands provision by His generosity.

name-al-khafid.title: Al-Khafid
name-al-khafid.subtitle: The Abaser
name-al-khafid.translation: The Abaser, who humbles whom He wills.

name-ar-rafi.title: Ar-Rafi'
name-ar-rafi.subtitle: The Exalter
name-ar-rafi.translation: The Exalter, who raises whom He wills in honour.

name-al-muizz.title: Al-Mu'izz
name-al-muizz.subtitle: The Giver of Honour
name-al-muizz.translation: The One who gives honour to whom He wills.

name-al-mudhill.title: Al-Mudhill
name-al-mudhill.subtitle: The Humiliator
name-al-mudhill.translation: The One who humbles whom He wills.

name-as-sami.title: As-Sami'
name-as-sami.subtitle: The All-Hearing
name-as-sami.translation: The All-Hearing, who hears every sound, spoken or silent.

name-al-basir.title: Al-Basir
name-al-basir.subtitle: The All-Seeing
name-al-basir.translation: The All-Seeing, who sees all things, however hidden.

name-al-hakam.title: Al-Hakam
name-al-hakam.subtitle: The Perfect Judge
name-al-hakam.translation: The Perfect Judge, whose ruling is always just.

name-al-adl.title: Al-Adl
name-al-adl.subtitle: The Utterly Just
name-al-adl.translation: The Utterly Just, free from any trace of unfairness.

name-al-latif.title: Al-Latif
name-al-latif.subtitle: The Subtle, Most Kind
name-al-latif.translation: The Subtle and Most Kind, aware of the finest details of His creation's needs.

name-al-khabir.title: Al-Khabir
name-al-khabir.subtitle: The All-Aware
name-al-khabir.translation: The All-Aware, fully acquainted with the reality of all things.

name-al-halim.title: Al-Halim
name-al-halim.subtitle: The Forbearing
name-al-halim.translation: The Forbearing, who delays punishment out of mercy.

name-al-azim.title: Al-Azim
name-al-azim.subtitle: The Magnificent
name-al-azim.translation: The Magnificent, whose greatness has no bound.

name-al-ghafur.title: Al-Ghafur
name-al-ghafur.subtitle: The All-Forgiving
name-al-ghafur.translation: The All-Forgiving, who covers and pardons sin.

name-ash-shakur.title: Ash-Shakur
name-ash-shakur.subtitle: The Most Appreciative
name-ash-shakur.translation: The Most Appreciative, who rewards even small acts of good generously.

name-al-aliyy.title: Al-Aliyy
name-al-aliyy.subtitle: The Most High
name-al-aliyy.translation: The Most High, exalted above all creation.

name-al-kabir.title: Al-Kabir
name-al-kabir.subtitle: The Most Great
name-al-kabir.translation: The Most Great, greater than anything that can be imagined.

name-al-hafiz.title: Al-Hafiz
name-al-hafiz.subtitle: The Preserver & Protector
name-al-hafiz.translation: The Preserver, who protects His creation and their deeds.

name-al-muqit.title: Al-Muqit
name-al-muqit.subtitle: The Nourisher
name-al-muqit.translation: The Nourisher, who sustains every soul with what it needs.

name-al-hasib.title: Al-Hasib
name-al-hasib.subtitle: The Reckoner
name-al-hasib.translation: The Reckoner, sufficient as a keeper of account.

name-al-jalil.title: Al-Jalil
name-al-jalil.subtitle: The Majestic
name-al-jalil.translation: The Majestic, possessor of greatness and honour.

name-al-karim.title: Al-Karim
name-al-karim.subtitle: The Generous & Noble
name-al-karim.translation: The Generous and Noble, giving abundantly without being asked.

name-ar-raqib.title: Ar-Raqib
name-ar-raqib.subtitle: The Ever-Watchful
name-ar-raqib.translation: The Ever-Watchful, observing all things at all times.

name-al-mujib.title: Al-Mujib
name-al-mujib.subtitle: The Responsive One
name-al-mujib.translation: The Responsive One, who answers the call of those who supplicate.

name-al-wasi.title: Al-Wasi'
name-al-wasi.subtitle: The All-Encompassing
name-al-wasi.translation: The All-Encompassing, whose mercy and knowledge embrace everything.

name-al-hakim.title: Al-Hakim
name-al-hakim.subtitle: The All-Wise
name-al-hakim.translation: The All-Wise, whose every decree carries perfect wisdom.

name-al-wadud.title: Al-Wadud
name-al-wadud.subtitle: The Loving One
name-al-wadud.translation: The Loving One, who loves and is beloved by the righteous.

name-al-majid.title: Al-Majid
name-al-majid.subtitle: The Most Glorious
name-al-majid.translation: The Most Glorious, possessor of perfect majesty.

name-al-baith.title: Al-Ba'ith
name-al-baith.subtitle: The Resurrector
name-al-baith.translation: The Resurrector, who will raise all creation on the Day of Judgement.

name-ash-shahid.title: Ash-Shahid
name-ash-shahid.subtitle: The Witness
name-ash-shahid.translation: The Witness, present and aware of everything without exception.

name-al-haqq.title: Al-Haqq
name-al-haqq.subtitle: The Truth
name-al-haqq.translation: The Truth, whose existence and promise are absolute.

name-al-wakil.title: Al-Wakil
name-al-wakil.subtitle: The Trusted Guardian
name-al-wakil.translation: The Trusted Guardian, sufficient for those who rely on Him.

name-al-qawiyy.title: Al-Qawiyy
name-al-qawiyy.subtitle: The All-Strong
name-al-qawiyy.translation: The All-Strong, whose strength never fails.

name-al-matin.title: Al-Matin
name-al-matin.subtitle: The Firm & Steadfast
name-al-matin.translation: The Firm, whose power is unshakeable.

name-al-waliyy.title: Al-Waliyy
name-al-waliyy.subtitle: The Protecting Ally
name-al-waliyy.translation: The Protecting Ally and Friend of the believers.

name-al-hamid.title: Al-Hamid
name-al-hamid.subtitle: The Praiseworthy
name-al-hamid.translation: The Praiseworthy, deserving of all praise in every state.

name-al-muhsi.title: Al-Muhsi
name-al-muhsi.subtitle: The Reckoner of All
name-al-muhsi.translation: The One who has counted and encompassed all things in knowledge.

name-al-mubdi.title: Al-Mubdi'
name-al-mubdi.subtitle: The Originator
name-al-mubdi.translation: The Originator, who began creation without precedent.

name-al-muid.title: Al-Mu'id
name-al-muid.subtitle: The Restorer
name-al-muid.translation: The Restorer, who will bring creation back after death.

name-al-muhyi.title: Al-Muhyi
name-al-muhyi.subtitle: The Giver of Life
name-al-muhyi.translation: The Giver of Life to all that lives.

name-al-mumit.title: Al-Mumit
name-al-mumit.subtitle: The Taker of Life
name-al-mumit.translation: The One who causes death at the appointed time.

name-al-hayy.title: Al-Hayy
name-al-hayy.subtitle: The Ever-Living
name-al-hayy.translation: The Ever-Living, whose life has no beginning and no end.

name-al-qayyum.title: Al-Qayyum
name-al-qayyum.subtitle: The Sustainer of All
name-al-qayyum.translation: The Sustainer, upon whom all creation depends for its existence.

name-al-wajid.title: Al-Wajid
name-al-wajid.subtitle: The Finder
name-al-wajid.translation: The Finder, who lacks nothing and finds all that He wills.

name-al-majid-2.title: Al-Majid
name-al-majid-2.subtitle: The Noble
name-al-majid-2.translation: The Noble, of perfect and abundant glory.

name-al-wahid.title: Al-Wahid
name-al-wahid.subtitle: The One
name-al-wahid.translation: The One, singular in His essence, attributes and actions.

name-as-samad.title: As-Samad
name-as-samad.subtitle: The Eternal Refuge
name-as-samad.translation: The Eternal Refuge, upon whom all creation depends while He depends on none.

name-al-qadir.title: Al-Qadir
name-al-qadir.subtitle: The Able
name-al-qadir.translation: The Able, capable of all things.

name-al-muqtadir.title: Al-Muqtadir
name-al-muqtadir.subtitle: The Omnipotent
name-al-muqtadir.translation: The Omnipotent, whose power overwhelms every obstacle.

name-al-muqaddim.title: Al-Muqaddim
name-al-muqaddim.subtitle: The Expediter
name-al-muqaddim.translation: The Expediter, who advances whom and what He wills.
name-al-muqaddim.reference: Traditional enumeration, derived from prophetic supplication (Muslim 1/534)

name-al-muakhkhir.title: Al-Mu'akhkhir
name-al-muakhkhir.subtitle: The Delayer
name-al-muakhkhir.translation: The Delayer, who defers whom and what He wills.
name-al-muakhkhir.reference: Traditional enumeration, derived from prophetic supplication (Muslim 1/534)

name-al-awwal.title: Al-Awwal
name-al-awwal.subtitle: The First
name-al-awwal.translation: The First, before whom nothing existed.

name-al-akhir.title: Al-Akhir
name-al-akhir.subtitle: The Last
name-al-akhir.translation: The Last, after whom nothing remains.

name-az-zahir.title: Az-Zahir
name-az-zahir.subtitle: The Manifest
name-az-zahir.translation: The Manifest, evident through the signs of His creation.

name-al-batin.title: Al-Batin
name-al-batin.subtitle: The Hidden
name-al-batin.translation: The Hidden, whose true essence cannot be perceived.

name-al-wali.title: Al-Wali
name-al-wali.subtitle: The Patron
name-al-wali.translation: The Patron, who governs and manages all affairs.

name-al-mutaali.title: Al-Muta'ali
name-al-mutaali.subtitle: The Most High
name-al-mutaali.translation: The Most High, transcendent above every limitation.

name-al-barr.title: Al-Barr
name-al-barr.subtitle: The Most Kind
name-al-barr.translation: The Most Kind, generous and gentle to His servants.

name-at-tawwab.title: At-Tawwab
name-at-tawwab.subtitle: The Accepter of Repentance
name-at-tawwab.translation: The Accepter of Repentance, who repeatedly turns to His servants in forgiveness.

name-al-muntaqim.title: Al-Muntaqim
name-al-muntaqim.subtitle: The Avenger
name-al-muntaqim.translation: The Avenger, who requites the wrongdoer with justice.

name-al-afuw.title: Al-Afuw
name-al-afuw.subtitle: The Pardoner
name-al-afuw.translation: The Pardoner, who erases sin entirely.

name-ar-rauf.title: Ar-Ra'uf
name-ar-rauf.subtitle: The Most Compassionate
name-ar-rauf.translation: The Most Compassionate, gentle with His creation.

name-al-muqsit.title: Al-Muqsit
name-al-muqsit.subtitle: The Just in Fairness
name-al-muqsit.translation: The Just, who deals with absolute fairness.

name-al-jami.title: Al-Jami'
name-al-jami.subtitle: The Gatherer
name-al-jami.translation: The Gatherer, who will assemble all creation on the Day of Judgement.

name-al-ghaniyy.title: Al-Ghaniyy
name-al-ghaniyy.subtitle: The Self-Sufficient
name-al-ghaniyy.translation: The Self-Sufficient, in need of nothing from His creation.

name-al-mughni.title: Al-Mughni
name-al-mughni.subtitle: The Enricher
name-al-mughni.translation: The Enricher, who grants sufficiency to whom He wills.

name-al-mani.title: Al-Mani'
name-al-mani.subtitle: The Preventer of Harm
name-al-mani.translation: The Preventer, who withholds harm from His servants.

name-ad-darr.title: Ad-Darr
name-ad-darr.subtitle: The Bringer of Harm
name-ad-darr.translation: The One from whom harm proceeds only by His wise decree.

name-an-nafi.title: An-Nafi'
name-an-nafi.subtitle: The Giver of Benefit
name-an-nafi.translation: The Giver of benefit to whomever He wills.

name-an-nur.title: An-Nur
name-an-nur.subtitle: The Light
name-an-nur.translation: The Light of the heavens and the earth.

name-al-hadi.title: Al-Hadi
name-al-hadi.subtitle: The Guide
name-al-hadi.translation: The Guide, who leads His servants to the straight path.

name-al-badi.title: Al-Badi'
name-al-badi.subtitle: The Incomparable Originator
name-al-badi.translation: The Incomparable Originator, who created without precedent or model.

name-al-baqi.title: Al-Baqi
name-al-baqi.subtitle: The Everlasting
name-al-baqi.translation: The Everlasting, who remains after all creation perishes.

name-al-warith.title: Al-Warith
name-al-warith.subtitle: The Inheritor
name-al-warith.translation: The Inheritor, to whom all things return.

name-ar-rashid.title: Ar-Rashid
name-ar-rashid.subtitle: The Guide to the Right Way
name-ar-rashid.translation: The Guide, whose wisdom directs all things to their proper end.

name-as-sabur.title: As-Sabur
name-as-sabur.subtitle: The Most Patient
name-as-sabur.translation: The Most Patient, who does not hasten in punishing.

name-malik-ul-mulk.title: Malik-ul-Mulk
name-malik-ul-mulk.subtitle: The Owner of All Sovereignty
name-malik-ul-mulk.translation: The Owner of all sovereignty, giving dominion to whom He wills.

name-dhul-jalal.title: Dhul-Jalali wal-Ikram
name-dhul-jalal.subtitle: Lord of Glory and Honour
name-dhul-jalal.translation: The Lord of Majesty and Generosity.

name-al-muhsin.title: Al-Muhsin
name-al-muhsin.subtitle: The Doer of Good
name-al-muhsin.translation: The Doer of Good, perfect in every action toward His creation.

other-expel-devil.title: Seeking Refuge from Satan
other-expel-devil.subtitle: To expel the devil and his whisperings
other-expel-devil.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed.
other-expel-devil.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 141 (Abu Dawud 1/206, At-Tirmidhi) — recited to expel whispers and distractions, especially in prayer

other-fear-shirk.title: Refuge from Shirk
other-fear-shirk.subtitle: For fear of associating partners with Allah, knowingly or not
other-fear-shirk.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا أَعْلَمُ
other-fear-shirk.translit: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika an ushrika bika wa anā a'lam, wa astaghfiruka limā lā a'lam.
other-fear-shirk.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I associate anything with You knowingly, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I know not.
other-fear-shirk.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 203 (Ahmad 4/403) — graded good by Al-Albani

other-childrens-protection.title: Protection for Children
other-childrens-protection.subtitle: Placing children under Allah's protection
other-childrens-protection.arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
other-childrens-protection.translit: U'īdhukumā bikalimāti-llāhit-tāmmati min kulli shayṭānin wa hāmmah, wa min kulli 'aynin lāmmah.
other-childrens-protection.translation: I seek protection for you both in the Perfect Words of Allah, from every devil and every beast, and from every envious, harmful eye.
other-childrens-protection.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 146 (Al-Bukhari 4/119) — the Prophet ﷺ would say this over Al-Hasan and Al-Husain

other-ward-off-devils.title: Warding off the Rebellious Devils
other-ward-off-devils.subtitle: To ward off the plot of the rebellious devils
other-ward-off-devils.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لَا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلَا فَاجِرٌ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَبَرَأَ وَذَرَأَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ إِلَّا طَارِقًا يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَٰنُ
other-ward-off-devils.translit: A'ūdhu bikalimāti-llāhit-tāmmāti llatī lā yujāwizuhunna barrun wa lā fājirun min sharri mā khalaq, wa bara'a wa dhara', wa min sharri mā yanzilu minas-samā', wa min sharri mā ya'ruju fīhā, wa min sharri mā dhara'a fil-arḍ, wa min sharri mā yakhruju minhā, wa min sharri fitani l-layli wan-nahār, wa min sharri kulli ṭāriqin illā ṭāriqan yaṭruqu bikhayr yā Raḥmān.
other-ward-off-devils.translation: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah — which neither the upright nor the corrupt may overcome — from the evil of what He created, of what He made and scattered, from the evil of what descends from the sky and what rises to it, from the evil of what He scattered in the earth and what emerges from it, from the evil trials of night and day, and from the evil of every visitor by night, except the visitor who brings good. O Most Merciful.
other-ward-off-devils.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 247 (Ahmad 3/419, Ibn As-Sunni 637) — chain graded authentic by Al-Arna'ut

other-distress-1.title: None Worthy of Worship but Allah
other-distress-1.subtitle: For one in distress
other-distress-1.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
other-distress-1.translit: Lā ilāha illallāhu l-'Aẓīmu l-Ḥalīm, lā ilāha illallāhu Rabbu l-'Arshi l-'Aẓīm, lā ilāha illallāhu Rabbu s-samāwāti wa Rabbu l-arḍi wa Rabbu l-'Arshi l-Karīm.
other-distress-1.translation: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

other-distress-2.title: Do Not Leave Me to Myself
other-distress-2.subtitle: For one in distress
other-distress-2.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
other-distress-2.translit: Allāhumma raḥmataka arjū falā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfata 'ayn, wa aṣliḥ lī sha'nī kullah, lā ilāha illā ant.
other-distress-2.translation: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy. Do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye. Correct all of my affairs for me. There is none worthy of worship but You.
other-distress-2.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 123 (Abu Dawud 4/324, Ahmad 5/42) — graded good by Al-Albani

other-distress-3.title: Glory Be to You, I Was of the Wrongdoers
other-distress-3.subtitle: For one in distress — the du'a of Yunus
other-distress-3.pointerNote: This is the same du'a of Yunus (peace be upon him) found in the Qur'anic Du'a section — recited here specifically at a moment of personal distress or hardship.
other-distress-3.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 124 (At-Tirmidhi 5/529, Al-Hakim, graded authentic by Adh-Dhahabi)

other-distress-4.title: Allah is My Lord
other-distress-4.subtitle: For one in distress
other-distress-4.arabic: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا
other-distress-4.translit: Allāh, Allāhu Rabbī lā ushriku bihi shay'ā.
other-distress-4.translation: Allah, Allah is my Lord. I do not associate anything with Him.
other-distress-4.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 125 (Abu Dawud 2/87) — graded authentic by Al-Albani

other-enemy-1.title: Restrain Them by Their Necks
other-enemy-1.subtitle: Upon encountering an enemy or authority
other-enemy-1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ
other-enemy-1.translit: Allāhumma innā naj'aluka fī nuḥūrihim, wa na'ūdhu bika min shurūrihim.
other-enemy-1.translation: O Allah, we ask You to restrain them by their necks, and we seek refuge in You from their evil.
other-enemy-1.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 126 (Abu Dawud 2/89) — graded authentic by Al-Hakim and Adh-Dhahabi

other-enemy-2.title: You Are My Strength
other-enemy-2.subtitle: Upon encountering an enemy or authority
other-enemy-2.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي وَأَنْتَ نَصِيرِي، بِكَ أَجُولُ وَبِكَ أَصُولُ وَبِكَ أُقَاتِلُ
other-enemy-2.translit: Allāhumma anta 'aḍudī, wa anta naṣīrī, bika ajūlu, wa bika aṣūlu, wa bika uqātil.
other-enemy-2.translation: O Allah, You are my strength and You are my support. For Your sake I go forth, for Your sake I advance, and for Your sake I fight.
other-enemy-2.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 127 (Abu Dawud 3/42, At-Tirmidhi 5/572) — graded authentic by Al-Albani

other-enemy-3.title: Allah is Sufficient for Us
other-enemy-3.subtitle: Upon encountering an enemy or authority
other-enemy-3.translation: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
other-enemy-3.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 128 (Al-Bukhari 5/172) — the words of Ibrahim (peace be upon him) when cast into the fire

other-affairs-difficult.title: There is No Ease Except What You Make Easy
other-affairs-difficult.subtitle: When affairs become difficult
other-affairs-difficult.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
other-affairs-difficult.translit: Allāhumma lā sahla illā mā ja'altahu sahlā, wa anta taj'alu l-ḥazna idhā shi'ta sahlā.
other-affairs-difficult.translation: O Allah, there is no ease except in what You have made easy, and You make sorrow easy if You wish.
other-affairs-difficult.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 139 (Ibn Hibban 2427, Ibn As-Sunni 351) — graded authentic by Ibn Hajar

other-travel.title: Du'a for Travel
other-travel.subtitle: Recited when setting out, and upon returning
other-travel.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ. سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى. اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
other-travel.translit: Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar. Subḥāna lladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahu muqrinīn, wa innā ilā Rabbinā lamunqalibūn. Allāhumma innā nas'aluka fī safarinā hādha l-birra wat-taqwā, wa mina l-'amali mā tarḍā. Allāhumma hawwin 'alaynā safaranā hādhā waṭwi 'annā bu'dah. Allāhumma anta ṣ-ṣāḥibu fis-safar, wal-khalīfatu fil-ahl. Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min wa'thā'is-safar, wa ka'ābati l-manẓar, wa sū'il-munqalabi fil-māli wal-ahl.
other-travel.translation: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, for we could never have accomplished it by ourselves. Surely to our Lord we are returning. O Allah, we ask You for righteousness and piety on this journey of ours, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, lighten this journey for us and make its distance easy. O Allah, You are our Companion on the road and the Guardian of our family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardships of travel, from a distressing sight, and from finding our family and property in misfortune upon returning. (Upon returning, repeat the same, adding: We return, repentant, worshipping, and praising our Lord.)

other-thunder.title: Upon Hearing Thunder
other-thunder.subtitle: Glorifying Allah, Whom thunder and angels glorify
other-thunder.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
other-thunder.translit: Subḥāna lladhī yusabbiḥu r-ra'du biḥamdihi wal-malā'ikatu min khīfatih.
other-thunder.translation: Glory is to Him Whom thunder glorifies with praise, and the angels too, out of fear of Him.
other-thunder.reference: Al-Muwatta 2/992 — the practice of Abdullah ibn az-Zubayr (RA), who would pause his conversation upon hearing thunder to recite this

other-rain-beneficial.title: A Beneficial Downpour
other-rain-beneficial.subtitle: When it begins to rain
other-rain-beneficial.translation: O Allah, (let it be) a beneficial rain cloud.

other-crescent-moon.title: Upon Sighting the Crescent Moon
other-crescent-moon.subtitle: At the start of a new month
other-crescent-moon.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ. اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ، وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضَى. رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
other-crescent-moon.translit: Allāhu Akbar. Allāhumma ahillahu 'alaynā bil-amni wal-īmān, was-salāmati wal-Islām, wat-tawfīqi limā tuḥibbu Rabbanā wa tarḍā. Rabbunā wa Rabbukallāh.
other-crescent-moon.translation: Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, bring this new moon upon us with security and faith, with peace and in Islam, and with guidance to that which You love and are pleased with. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.
other-crescent-moon.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 175 (At-Tirmidhi 5/504, Ad-Darimi 1/336) — graded authentic by Al-Albani

other-sneezing.title: Upon Sneezing
other-sneezing.subtitle: The exchange between the one who sneezes and those nearby
other-sneezing.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ← يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ ← يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
other-sneezing.translit: [Sneezer says:] Alḥamdulillāh. [Others reply:] Yarḥamukallāh. [Sneezer then says:] Yahdīkumullāhu wa yuṣliḥu bālakum.
other-sneezing.translation: [Sneezer:] Praise be to Allah. [Others:] May Allah have mercy on you. [Sneezer replies:] May Allah guide you and set right your affairs.
other-sneezing.reference: Al-Bukhari 6224, and Hisn al-Muslim Ch. 77 — an etiquette of mutual remembrance among Muslims

other-anger.title: When Angry
other-anger.subtitle: Seeking refuge from Satan's provocation
other-anger.pointerNote: The same 'A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim' found under Protection above — recited specifically to calm anger.

other-qunoot-witr.title: Qunoot al-Witr
other-qunoot-witr.subtitle: Recited in the third rak'ah of Witr prayer
other-qunoot-witr.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ، وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ، إِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ، وَإِنَّهُ لَا يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ وَلَا يَعِزُّ مَنْ عَادَيْتَ، تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَتَعَالَيْتَ
other-qunoot-witr.translit: Allāhumma-hdinī fīman hadayt, wa 'āfinī fīman 'āfayt, wa tawallanī fīman tawallayt, wa bārik lī fīmā a'ṭayt, wa qinī sharra mā qaḍayt, innaka taqḍī wa lā yuqḍā 'alayk, wa innahu lā yadhillu man wālayt, wa lā ya'izzu man 'ādayt, tabārakta Rabbanā wa ta'ālayt.
other-qunoot-witr.translation: O Allah, guide me among those You have guided, pardon me among those You have pardoned, take me into Your care among those You have taken into Your care, bless me in what You have granted, and protect me from the evil You have decreed. Indeed You decree, and none decrees over You. He whom You befriend is not humiliated, nor is he honoured whom You oppose. Blessed are You, our Lord, and Exalted.
other-qunoot-witr.reference: Hisn al-Muslim (Sunan Abi Dawud 1425) — taught by the Prophet ﷺ to his grandson Al-Hasan ibn Ali

other-visiting-sick-1.title: It Will Be a Purification
other-visiting-sick-1.subtitle: When visiting the sick
other-visiting-sick-1.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
other-visiting-sick-1.translation: Do not worry, it will be a purification for you, Allah willing.

other-visiting-sick-2.title: I Ask Allah to Heal You
other-visiting-sick-2.subtitle: When visiting the sick — recite seven times
other-visiting-sick-2.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
other-visiting-sick-2.translit: As'alullāha l-'Aẓīma Rabba l-'Arshi l-'Aẓīmi an yashfiyak. (×7)
other-visiting-sick-2.translation: I ask Almighty Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, to heal you.
other-visiting-sick-2.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 148 (At-Tirmidhi, Abu Dawud) — recite seven times, graded authentic by Al-Albani

other-condolence.title: Words of Condolence
other-condolence.subtitle: To offer comfort after a loss
other-condolence.arabic: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى، فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ
other-condolence.translit: Inna lillāhi mā akhadh, wa lahu mā a'ṭā, wa kullu shay'in 'indahu bi-ajalin musammā, faltaṣbir wal-taḥtasib.
other-condolence.translation: Surely to Allah belongs what He takes, and to Him belongs what He gives; everything with Him has an appointed time. So be patient and seek reward.

pb-fajr-protection.title: Fajr: Under Allah's Protection
pb-fajr-protection.subtitle: Sahih Muslim 657a
pb-fajr-protection.arabic: مَنْ صَلَّى الصُّبْحَ فَهُوَ فِي ذِمَّةِ اللَّهِ فَلاَ يَطْلُبَنَّكُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ ذِمَّتِهِ بِشَىْءٍ فَيُدْرِكَهُ فَيَكُبَّهُ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ
pb-fajr-protection.translit: Man ṣallā aṣ-ṣubḥa fahuwa fī dhimmatillāh, falā yaṭlubannakumullāhu min dhimmatihī bishay'in fayudrikahū fayakubbahū fī nāri jahannam.
pb-fajr-protection.translation: Whoever prays the morning (Fajr) prayer is under the protection of Allah — so do not violate that protection in any way, for whoever does, Allah will seize him and throw him down on his face into the Fire of Hell.

pb-fajr-asr-jannah.title: Fajr + Asr → Paradise
pb-fajr-asr-jannah.subtitle: Sahih al-Bukhari 574
pb-fajr-asr-jannah.translation: Whoever prays the two cool prayers (Fajr and Asr) will enter Paradise.

pb-fajr-angels.title: Fajr & Asr: Witnessed by Angels
pb-fajr-angels.subtitle: Sahih al-Bukhari 555
pb-fajr-angels.arabic: يَتَعَاقَبُونَ فِيكُمْ مَلاَئِكَةٌ بِاللَّيْلِ وَمَلاَئِكَةٌ بِالنَّهَارِ، وَيَجْتَمِعُونَ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ وَصَلاَةِ الْعَصْرِ
pb-fajr-angels.translit: Yata'āqabūna fīkum malā'ikatun bil-layli wa malā'ikatun bin-nahār, wa yajtami'ūna fī ṣalāti al-fajri wa ṣalāti al-'aṣr.
pb-fajr-angels.translation: Angels come to you in succession by night and by day, and they gather together at the Fajr and Asr prayers.

pb-dhuhr-fire.title: Dhuhr: 4 Before + 4 After → Protection from the Fire
pb-dhuhr-fire.subtitle: Sunan at-Tirmidhi 428
pb-dhuhr-fire.arabic: مَنْ حَافَظَ عَلَى أَرْبَعِ رَكَعَاتٍ قَبْلَ الظُّهْرِ وَأَرْبَعٍ بَعْدَهَا حَرَّمَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى النَّارِ
pb-dhuhr-fire.translit: Man ḥāfaẓa 'alā arba'i raka'ātin qabla aẓ-ẓuhri wa arba'in ba'dahā ḥarramahullāhu 'alan-nār.
pb-dhuhr-fire.translation: Whoever preserves four rak'ahs before Dhuhr and four after it, Allah will forbid him from the Fire.

pb-asr-warning.title: Asr: Severe Warning Against Abandoning It
pb-asr-warning.subtitle: Sahih al-Bukhari 553
pb-asr-warning.arabic: مَنْ تَرَكَ صَلاَةَ الْعَصْرِ فَقَدْ حَبِطَ عَمَلُهُ
pb-asr-warning.translit: Man taraka ṣalāta al-'aṣri faqad ḥabiṭa 'amaluh.
pb-asr-warning.translation: Whoever leaves the Asr prayer, his deeds are nullified.

pb-maghrib-house.title: Maghrib: Part of the Twelve Sunnah Rak'ahs
pb-maghrib-house.subtitle: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 415
pb-maghrib-house.arabic: مَنْ صَلَّى فِي يَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ ثِنْتَىْ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً بُنِيَ لَهُ بَيْتٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ أَرْبَعًا قَبْلَ الظُّهْرِ وَرَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَهَا وَرَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَرَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ وَرَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ
pb-maghrib-house.translit: Man ṣallā fī yawmin wa laylatin thintay 'ashrata rak'atan buniya lahu baytun fī al-jannah...
pb-maghrib-house.translation: Whoever prays twelve rak'ahs in a day and night — four before Dhuhr and two after, two after Maghrib, two after Isha, and two before Fajr — a house will be built for him in Paradise.

pb-isha-half-night.title: Isha in Congregation → Half a Night's Worship
pb-isha-half-night.subtitle: Sahih Muslim 656 / Tirmidhi 221
pb-isha-half-night.arabic: مَنْ شَهِدَ الْعِشَاءَ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ كَانَ لَهُ قِيَامُ نِصْفِ لَيْلَةٍ
pb-isha-half-night.translit: Man shahida al-'ishā'a fī jamā'atin kāna lahu qiyāmu niṣfi laylah.
pb-isha-half-night.translation: Whoever attends Isha in congregation, it is as if he had stood half the night in prayer.
pb-isha-half-night.reference: Sahih Muslim 656 / Jami' at-Tirmidhi 221 — Grade: Sahih

pb-isha-fajr-whole-night.title: Isha + Fajr in Congregation → a Whole Night's Worship
pb-isha-fajr-whole-night.subtitle: Sahih Muslim 656 / Tirmidhi 221
pb-isha-fajr-whole-night.arabic: وَمَنْ صَلَّى الْعِشَاءَ وَالْفَجْرَ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ كَانَ لَهُ كَقِيَامِ لَيْلَةٍ
pb-isha-fajr-whole-night.translit: Wa man ṣallā al-'ishā'a wal-fajra fī jamā'atin kāna lahu ka qiyāmi laylah.
pb-isha-fajr-whole-night.translation: And whoever prays Isha and Fajr in congregation, it is as if he had stood the whole night in prayer.
pb-isha-fajr-whole-night.reference: Sahih Muslim 656 / Jami' at-Tirmidhi 221 — Grade: Sahih

pb-isha-hypocrites.title: Isha & Fajr: Immense Reward Despite the Difficulty
pb-isha-hypocrites.subtitle: Sahih al-Bukhari 657 / Muslim 651
pb-isha-hypocrites.arabic: لَيْسَ صَلاَةٌ أَثْقَلَ عَلَى الْمُنَافِقِينَ مِنَ الْفَجْرِ وَالْعِشَاءِ، وَلَوْ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا فِيهِمَا لأَتَوْهُمَا وَلَوْ حَبْوًا
pb-isha-hypocrites.translit: Laysa ṣalātun athqalu 'alal-munāfiqīna minal-fajri wal-'ishā'i, wa law ya'lamūna mā fīhimā la'atawhumā wa law ḥabwā.
pb-isha-hypocrites.translation: No prayer is heavier upon the hypocrites than Fajr and Isha; if they knew what reward is in them, they would come to them even if they had to crawl.
pb-isha-hypocrites.reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 657 / Sahih Muslim 651 — Grade: Muttafaqun Alayhi (agreed upon)

pb-universal-expiate.title: All Five Prayers Erase Sins Between Them
pb-universal-expiate.subtitle: Sahih Muslim 233a
pb-universal-expiate.arabic: الصَّلَوَاتُ الْخَمْسُ، وَالْجُمُعَةُ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ، وَرَمَضَانُ إِلَى رَمَضَانَ، مُكَفِّرَاتٌ مَا بَيْنَهُنَّ إِذَا اجْتَنَبَ الْكَبَائِرَ
pb-universal-expiate.translit: Aṣ-ṣalawātu al-khamsu, wal-jumu'atu ilā al-jumu'ah, wa ramaḍānu ilā ramaḍān, mukaffirātun mā baynahunna idhā ijtanaba al-kabā'ir.
pb-universal-expiate.translation: The five daily prayers, one Friday prayer to the next, and one Ramadan to the next, are expiation for whatever comes between them, so long as major sins are avoided.

pb-fajr-two-rakat.title: Fajr: The Two Sunnah Rak'ahs Are Better Than the World
pb-fajr-two-rakat.subtitle: Sahih Muslim 725a
pb-fajr-two-rakat.arabic: رَكْعَتَا الْفَجْرِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا
pb-fajr-two-rakat.translit: Rak'atā al-fajri khayrun min ad-dunyā wa mā fīhā.
pb-fajr-two-rakat.translation: The two rak'ahs before Fajr are better than this world and everything in it.

pb-dhuhr-gates-heaven.title: Dhuhr: An Hour When the Gates of Heaven Open
pb-dhuhr-gates-heaven.subtitle: Sunan Ibn Majah 1157
pb-dhuhr-gates-heaven.arabic: إِنَّ أَبْوَابَ السَّمَاءِ تُفْتَحُ إِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ
pb-dhuhr-gates-heaven.translit: Inna abwāba as-samā'i tuftaḥu idhā zālati ash-shams.
pb-dhuhr-gates-heaven.translation: The gates of heaven are opened when the sun passes its zenith — the Prophet ﷺ used this time before Dhuhr, saying he loved for his good deeds to rise up in that hour.
pb-dhuhr-gates-heaven.reference: Sunan Ibn Majah 1157 — Grade: Hasan (Al-Albani, Sahih al-Jami)

pb-asr-lost-family.title: Asr: Missing It Is Like Losing Family and Wealth
pb-asr-lost-family.subtitle: Sahih al-Bukhari 552 / Muslim 626
pb-asr-lost-family.arabic: الَّذِي تَفُوتُهُ صَلاَةُ الْعَصْرِ كَأَنَّمَا وُتِرَ أَهْلَهُ وَمَالَهُ
pb-asr-lost-family.translit: Alladhī tafūtuhu ṣalātu al-'aṣri ka'annamā wutira ahlahu wa mālah.
pb-asr-lost-family.translation: Whoever misses the Asr prayer, it is as if he had lost his family and his wealth.
pb-asr-lost-family.reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 552 / Sahih Muslim 626 — Grade: Muttafaqun Alayhi (agreed upon)

pb-asr-four-before.title: Asr: A Prophetic Supplication for Whoever Prays Four Before It
pb-asr-four-before.subtitle: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 430
pb-asr-four-before.arabic: رَحِمَ اللَّهُ امْرَأً صَلَّى قَبْلَ الْعَصْرِ أَرْبَعًا
pb-asr-four-before.translit: Raḥima Allāhu imra'an ṣallā qabla al-'aṣri arba'an.
pb-asr-four-before.translation: May Allah have mercy on a person who prays four rak'ahs before Asr.
